symptom: Making `verify` the gate in the generated CLAUDE.md (ako/mxcli#2438) was meant to reach new projects only. It reached every bootstrapped project: the session-start bootstrap runs `mxcli init --sync-skills .` each session, which regenerates the mxcli section of CLAUDE.md, so an upgraded mxcli replaced `lint` and `docker check` with `verify` in projects that had no verify-baseline/. Without baselines verify reports every finding the project already had as new, and a project with errors fails on its whole backlog.
cause: The gate list was a single package-level list chosen when mxcli was built, and the generator had no way to see the project: ToolFile.Content takes only the project name and the .mpr file name. I assumed init-time generation (the PR text and proposal question 12 said existing projects keep their old list) without reading what `--sync-skills` regenerates. The sync path (init_tooling_sync.go) re-renders owned docs from the same list on every session start.
file: `cmd/mxcli/init_claudemd.go` (classicGates, verifyGates, hasVerifyBaseline, projectGatesFor, generateClaudeMDIn), `cmd/mxcli/tool_templates.go` (ToolFile.ContentIn, render), `cmd/mxcli/init.go`, `init_tooling_sync.go`, `cmd_add_tool.go`; tests in `cmd/mxcli/init_claudemd_gates_test.go`.
insight: Before changing generated text that lives in a project's own files, find every path that regenerates it, not only the one that creates it: a sync that runs unattended every session turns a binary upgrade into a change of every project's instructions. The fix makes the generated list a function of the project (the verify gate list only when verify-baseline/lint.json exists), so recording the baselines moves a project onto verify at the next sync and an upgrade alone moves nothing. A test must exercise the sync path with and without the file (TestSyncMovesAProjectOnAndOffTheVerifyGateList), not only the generator, because the generator alone cannot show who calls it. Found by asking what the risk of the default was and then reading init --sync-skills; the ChipCoV14 clone's own .claude/bootstrap-mxcli.sh showed the call.
